Looping in a short note on capacity: we can likely absorb a short burst for Acme under Dedicated if we reallocate one of the burst pools, but that will degrade other customers in that pool by ~10-15% during the window unless we schedule a rolling window outside peak. Two items to surface to execs:
1) If we promise burst guarantee to Acme we need a defined isolation plan + temporary pool reassignments (ops overhead).
2) If routing fallback requires vendor-style quantization (e.g., 4-bit variant) we must accept a small quality delta; Ops can run the canary but we need an explicit rollback timeline and runbook.

I recommend we present a clear operational cost (hours+risk) in the QBR one-pager so execs can make an informed call. I will add the cost estimate to the tracker by 3pm.

Vivek
VP, Infrastructure
